note: Public facts about the Google Play app (no secrets: fingerprints of public certificates only). tools/apk/play_codes.py reads it before every AAB / preview APK build and records each new versionCode. Keys live in dist/ (git-ignored) and are lost when the container restarts: restore them from the designer's backup before a build.
track: 비공개 테스트 - 눈꽃마을 비공개 테스트 (not the empty default 비공개 테스트 track)

uploadKey.acceptedBy: Play: 4310 (4.3.0-a2) released to the closed test on 2026-11-08, 4312 (4.3.0-a2.2) added from the library on 2026-11-09

testKey.use: the sideloaded test APKs (com.snowbloom.village) and the universal APK made from each bundle

troubleshooting.wrongKey: Play says the bundle is signed with the wrong key: check the console is on this app (package above) and its 눈꽃마을 비공개 테스트 track; this upload key is the one Play accepted. If Play really expects another key, ask for an upload key reset with dist/play/snowbloom-upload-certificate.pem.
troubleshooting.codeUsed: Play says the versionCode is already used: the bundle is already in the app's library (a first try that half-failed) — remove it from the upload box and use 라이브러리에서 추가, or build again with the next code.
